scope: Resolve secondary procedures prospectively, without changing primary hypotheses, gates, fitted artifacts, cutoffs, the failed numerical comparison or GMM 28/252 audit. These decisions are development-informed: the recorded development outcomes were already known. They are not retroactively preregistered confirmatory tests.
implementation: secondary_metrics.py implements the saved-score metrics and fixed McNemar/Holm family below. Drift comparators, perturbations and secondary fitting remain specified development work, not executed or complete. This contract alone authorizes no additional fit or protected-data read; separate immutable fit/calibration contracts and the complete source/execution freeze must precede those operations.
populations: Report internal group-test and external NCSC-gold plus certified-registry populations separately. Preserve the observed external mixture denominator; it is not deployment prevalence. Four primary detectors are paired on each, with policy additionally external. Silver/bronze positive recall stays separately source/tier identified. Tranco is label-free controls and never enters AP, calibration or labeled classification metrics.
score_and_decision: Use frozen binary decisions for confusion metrics. Use saved full-precision length, Logistic-L1, transformer or routed cascade/policy probability for ranking/calibration. A cascade's heterogeneous component thresholds mean its ranking curve need not reproduce its frozen binary policy. No metric fits a calibrator or selects a replacement deployment cutoff.

metrics.confusion: Retain TP,FP,TN,FN,P,N. Precision=TP/(TP+FP); F2=5TP/(5TP+4FN+FP); balanced_accuracy=(TP/P+TN/N)/2; MCC uses its ordinary four-marginal denominator. Undefined denominators produce null with a specific reason.
metrics.ranking: Use pinned scikit-learn 1.7.2 average_precision_score (stepwise AP, not trapezoidal PR area) and roc_auc_score with tied-score half credit. Require both classes for AP/AUC and recall-at-FPR comparisons; otherwise report non-estimability.
metrics.recall_at_1pct_fpr: Consider every distinct saved score threshold plus finite nextafter(max,+infinity), predicting score>=threshold. Maximize TP/P subject to integer 100*FP<=N; ties use smaller FP, then higher threshold. Never split ties or interpolate. Report cutoff and achieved counts as a descriptive test-curve point, not a selected deployable operating point.
metrics.brier: float64 mean((probability-label)^2), without probability recalibration; a smaller Brier score alone does not establish better calibration.
metrics.ece: Ten half-open equal-width bins, last inclusive of 1. Construct the nine internal float64 boundaries as numpy.arange(1,10,dtype=float64)/10 and assign with searchsorted(side='right'); do not multiply probabilities by 10 and floor because adjacent-float rounding can cross an edge. ECE=sum n_b/n * abs(mean_label_b-mean_probability_b). Empty bins contribute zero weight and have null means. Retain count, positive count, probability sum and squared-error sum per bin.
metrics.prevalence_projection: For pi=.001,.01,.05, expected alerts per 10,000=10000*(pi*TPR+(1-pi)*FPR), misses=10000*pi*(1-TPR), false alerts=10000*(1-pi)*FPR. Report originating population and rates; these projections assume class-conditional rates transport and are not measured replay counts.

mcnemar_holm.population: Aligned positive records only in the named internal/gold stratum; compare paired correctness of candidate and reference frozen decisions.
mcnemar_holm.test: For discordances b,c use scipy.stats.binomtest(b,b+c,p=.5,alternative='two-sided'). No discordances gives p=1; no records is unavailable. Retain the complete paired 2x2 table.
mcnemar_holm.adjustment: Holm across exactly four fixed cells. Sort by(p,stable_test_id); adjusted sorted p_i=min(1,max_{j<=i}((4-j)*p_j)) using zero-based j. Missing/unestimable cells retain family slots as computational p=1 but remain publicly null/unavailable; never prune the family after outcomes.
mcnemar_holm.interpretation: Nominal dependence-limited secondary p-values, not primary-gate significance. Repeated domains violate independent discordant-pair assumptions; Holm cannot repair invalid constituent p-values. Primary inference remains the frozen domain-clustered bootstrap.

development_methods.mmd: Use the existing training-standardized 26-dimensional monitor representation. Choose the smallest stable-ID row per domain, then the first 256 domains ordered by SHA256('secondary-mmd-reference-v1:20260816:'+canonical_domain), with ties resolved by canonical domain. Fewer than 256 domains is not_estimable. RBF bandwidth_squared is the linear median of strictly positive squared pairwise reference distances; no positive distance is not_estimable. Kernel: exp(-distance_squared/(2*bandwidth_squared)). Use biased MMD_squared including diagonals, evaluated as float64 mean(KRR)+mean(KWW)-2*mean(KRW), C-contiguous kernel arrays, and the original 256-row windows at stride 64. Fix the reference before validation. Calibrate one strict boundary at the existing calibration stream's linear 95th percentile; evaluate the unchanged audit and external stream without retuning. This is an empirically calibrated comparator, not an independent-window hypothesis test.
development_methods.psi: Use the same 26-dimensional representation. Fit featurewise training deciles with linear quantiles, deduplicate internal edges, use infinite outer edges, and assign bins with searchsorted on internal edges, side='right'. A constant training feature uses three categories: below, equal to, and above the constant. Smooth counts with 0.5 per bin, denominator n+0.5*K. PSI=sum((q-p)*log(q/p)), with training proportions p and window proportions q. The aggregate window score is the maximum across 26 features; retain each feature's score. Calibrate the aggregate at the existing calibration stream's linear 95th percentile, then evaluate audit and external windows without retuning. No conventional 0.1/0.25 cutoffs or H2 rescue claim.
development_methods.perturbations: Development-validation audit order only. Create separate, noncomposed copies for ASCII scheme/host uppercasing, valid percent-escape hex uppercasing, and percent-encoding the first literal ASCII alphanumeric in the path. Preserve originals, mappings, eligibility, changed/no-op counts and exact operator output; never fetch URLs. Measure detector/monitor score, decision and alert changes. Transformed URLs do not inherit verified outcome labels, are not adversarial-success observations and never enter primary H2 evidence.
development_methods.formatting: One secondary training-only Logistic-L1 pipeline over five fixed indicators: uppercase ASCII scheme, uppercase ASCII host, lowercase hex in valid percent escapes, explicit scheme-default port, and empty path. Use the declared baseline scaler/SAGA configuration and validation CP threshold rule, with exact feature implementations frozen before fitting. Predictive serialization associations are not proof of source causation.
development_methods.source_shortcut: A PhiUSIIL source-only model is not identifiable from the available per-record provenance; record this precise unavailable analysis rather than inventing sources from labels. External source-by-label contingency summaries describe source confounding but do not replace that experiment or authorize external fitting.
development_methods.label_permutation: Five negative-control Logistic-L1 fits, independently permuting training labels with fresh PCG64 seeds 42-46 in pinned row order; features and class totals remain unchanged. Evaluate unchanged validation labels and report AP, AUC and counts descriptively, without a permutation-test p-value or model-selection claim.
development_methods.seed_sensitivity: Retain the promised transformer seeds 42-46 conditional on the same frozen stage-one model. Reuse accepted seed 42 weights and specify four secondary fits for seeds 43-46 without changing primary artifacts. Report every seed and failure; never select the best. Before fitting, the dedicated secondary contract must resolve the exact training runtime, checkpoint-scoring convention and comparable secondary threshold/band calibration for all five seeds. Historical primary seed 42 cutoffs remain unchanged. Do not call runtime or calibration differences a pure random-seed effect.
development_methods.random_forest: One no-search secondary structural benchmark over all 25 features, scikit-learn 1.7.2: 100 trees, gini, max_features='sqrt', max_depth=None, min_samples_split=2, min_samples_leaf=1, bootstrap=True, class_weight='balanced', random_state=42, n_jobs=1, oob_score=False, warm_start=False. The dedicated fit contract records every effective parameter and portable serialization/verification before execution. Fit on training data only and select a separate cutoff with the validation CP rule. No probability recalibration, cascade insertion or promotion to primary evidence.

one_pass_requirements: Retain ordered identities, domains, publisher labels, roles and provenance; all model/seed score-decision pairs; 25 features and the separate portable monitor probability; NLL/window/routing evidence; scoring audits; and immutable replay manifests. All secondary models, reference samples, bins, probes and required outputs must be fixed before the protected pass. Saving probabilities now does not retroactively prespecify an omitted analysis.
